idea-plugin.name: MASMLD GNU Linker Script
idea-plugin.description:
Independent GNU ld linker-script support for IntelliJ Platform IDEs.

  • Dedicated .ld file type and file icons.
  • Syntax highlighting and tolerant structural parsing.
  • Offline Chinese quick documentation for 48 linker commands and built-in functions.

Requires MASMLD Core; no CPU architecture module or RISC-V selection is required. Enable quick documentation on hover in editor settings. Includes symbol/region/section completion and navigation, INCLUDE, find usages, rename, constant analysis, layout hints, structure, folding and formatting. The plugin does not run the linker or expand templates.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.8 development: contextual completion and parameter hints; include-aware symbols; ISA configuration and diagnostics; find usages and rename; structure, folding and formatting; GNU ld expressions and layout hints; optional binary symbol/debug-source navigation. See the repository changelog for coverage and limitations.
